desc:
Drag Drive Simulator (DDS / RDID Revamp) is a Roleplay Game that has realistic features like the real world. You can drive, play, and roleplay with friends in a fun way !! 😄

❤️ NEW CODE : DRAGDRIVESIMULATORSEPTEMBER26 +4 MORE CODES
Next Code releasing at 200000 Likes❓❓

⭐️ BETA V1.1.9 [WHEELIE STYLE x BIG UPDATE] :
- New Special Trick System: Wheelie Style 🚀
- Map Expansion Surakarta: Gatsu Street 🗺️
- Added 6 new Limited Special Vehicles
- Added many new Standard Cars & Motorcycles
- New Modification System: Wide Rims Type, Material, & Accessories 🔧
- 5 Wheelie Styles with Wheelie Speed & Angle Tuning
- New Dynamic Vehicle Camera: First Person & 360 Action Cam
- New Favorite Vehicle Spawner ⭐
- Rims Type System Rework
- Added 5 new Redeem Codes
- Bug Fixes & Many More!

Don't forget to click Like (👍) and Favorites (⭐️) the game

If you have suggestions or find bugs, please report it on the social links below.

badges.name: Wheelie Rider: One Minute Balance!
badges.desc: Congratulations! You've completed the one-minute wheelie challenge! Enjoy this special badge as a reward for your riding skills. Keep Freestyle! 🏍️🏆⭐

badges.name: Superman Style Master: Like a Hero!
badges.desc: Congratulations! You've unlocked the Superman riding style on 10 different motorcycles! Faster Drag. As a reward, enjoy this special badge and a 20M cash bonus! 🦸🏍️💰

badges.name: Wheelie Style Master: All Tricks!
badges.desc: Congratulations! You've unlocked the Handstand wheelie style on 10 different motorcycles! You become a professional freestyler. As a reward, enjoy this special badge and a 25M cash bonus! 🏍️🏆💰

badges.name: RideGO Job: First Order!
badges.desc: Congratulations! You've successfully started your career as a RideGO Driver! As a reward for completing your very first order, enjoy this exclusive badge to mark the beginning of your journey! 🛵🔰

badges.name: Silver Driver: First Promotion!
badges.desc: Congratulations! You've been promoted to Silver Driver! As a reward for your hard work and reaching 2,000 XP, enjoy this badge and a 5M cash bonus! Keep riding! 🛵⭐

badges.name: Anomaly Passenger: Unknown Rider!
badges.desc: Congratulations? You've successfully delivered a first passenger that... definitely isn't human. As a reward for your bravery in facing this anomaly, enjoy this badge and a 25M cash bonus! Don't look at your mirror! 💀👻

badges.name: RideGO Hunter: 13 Anomalies!
badges.desc: Congratulations! You've successfully collected 13 different types of Anomalies! As a reward for your thorough investigation into the paranormal, enjoy this special badge and a huge 50M cash bonus! 🕵️💀💰

badges.name: Gold Driver: Advanced Rank!
badges.desc: Congratulations! You've reached the rank of Gold Driver! Your dedication and skill (10,000 XP) have paid off. As a reward, enjoy this badge and a 10M cash bonus! You are a pro now! 🥇🛵

badges.name: Elite Driver: Legend of the Street!
badges.desc: Congratulations! You've achieved the highest rank, Elite Driver! You are a true legend of the streets (30,000 XP). As a reward, enjoy this prestigious badge and a massive 25M cash bonus! 👑🛵✨

badges.name: Millionaire: Earning the First 500M!
badges.desc: Congratulations, you've successfully earned the first 500M! Enjoy a 10M cash

badges.name: Billionaire: Earning the First 1B!
badges.desc: Congratulations, you've successfully earned the first 1B! Enjoy a 50M cash

badges.name: Anomaly Collector: Brainrot!
badges.desc: Congratulations! You have successfully collected 4 brainrot anomalies, found each week. As a reward, you get a special badge and a bonus prize! 🧠✨

badges.name: Anomaly Barista Visitor: Unknown Entity!
badges.desc: Congratulations? You've successfully served a customer that... definitely isn't human. As a reward for your bravery in facing this anomaly, enjoy this badge and a 25M cash bonus! Watch your back! 💀👻

badges.name: Anomaly Barista Menu: Cursed Recipe!
badges.desc: Congratulations! You've successfully discovered a forbidden or glitchy coffee recipe! As a reward for crafting this strange item, enjoy this badge and a 25M cash bonus! Just don't drink it yourself! 🧪🍵

Good Ending: Ramadan x LNY Event 2026! ✨

badges.name: Bad Ending: Ramadan x LNY Event 2026! 🦹‍
badges.desc: Congratulations! You've successfully completed Bad Ending! As a reward, enjoy a badge and cash prize! ✅🦹‍

badges.name: Secret Ending: Ramadan x LNY Event 2026! 🧧
badges.desc: Congratulations! You've successfully completed Secret Ending! As a reward, enjoy a badge and cash prize! ✅🧧

badges.name: Barista Job: First Shift!
badges.desc: Congratulations! You've successfully started your career at the Cafe! As a reward for clocking in your very first shift, enjoy this exclusive badge to mark the beginning of your journey! ☕🔰

badges.name: Junior Barista: First Promotion!
badges.desc: Congratulations! You've been promoted to Junior Barista! As a reward for your hard work and reaching 5,000 XP, enjoy this badge and a 5M cash bonus! Keep brewing! ☕⭐

badges.name: Senior Barista: Expert Brewer!
badges.desc: Congratulations! You've reached the rank of Senior Barista! Your dedication and skill (25,000 XP) have paid off. As a reward, enjoy this badge and a 10M cash bonus! You are a pro now! 🥈☕
